page.overview:
Who is Beetle?

The Beetle is a large beetle that is green in color and wears purple racing gear.

The Beetle can be first seen in Angry Aztec where she is encountered by Tiny Kong in the tower after shrinking herself and being dropped in there by Squawks the Parrot. The Beetle tells Tiny that she must beat her in a race and collect 50 coins. However, if Tiny either falls off of the course or doesn't have 50 coins by the finish line, the Beetle will win laughing at Tiny's failure.

The Beetle can be encountered again later at Crystal Caves, this time, by Lanky Kong. As usual, Lanky must beat the Beetle in a race using mainly his OrangStand Sprint technique to give him an edge. However, losing will result in being taunted by the Beetle once more.
